scope: Segment 114 field-level rules, serialization, applicability, and companion-segment scope within the Loyalty Card Transaction Request
extractionEvidence: regression-artifact-validator/docs/specs/extracted_text.txt lines 12861-12900 (Section 12.13), lines 7986-8090 (Section 11.2.1), lines 7511-7546 (Section 11.1.1), lines 8100-8140 (Section 11.3.1), lines 10460-10490 (Section 11.9.1), 13-data-elements.md row for Element 149

rules.title: Segment 114 is exclusive to the Loyalty Card Transaction Request's Data Section 3; it is not documented as a companion in the Financial Transaction Request (11.1.1), ECA/TeleCheck Service Transaction Request (11.3.1), or CA Public Key File Load Request (11.9.1) Data Section 3 lists
rules.note: REOPENED 2026-09-29 (SEG114-SME-002): the Chapter 12 segment/transaction matrix marks Segment 114 in the Financial Transaction Request and EMV Financial Transaction Request columns, and Element 63's Financial Transaction Request processing rule defers Data Section 3 content to Chapter 12. Only the Section 11.1.1 layout table omits Segment 114. Held at REVIEW_REQUIRED.

rules.title: Segment 114 is optional in every Loyalty Card Transaction Request, always in Field No. 5 of Data Section No. 3, alongside the required Segment 108 in Field No. 4
Segment Type is fixed value 114
rules.note: RESOLVED 2026-09-26 (SEG114-SME-004): user confirmed SegmentType == '114' is enforced as a hard rule despite Section 12.13 not printing an explicit 'Fixed value: 114' phrase (contrast Section 12.14 for Segment 115, which does).

rules.title: Segment Length is 4 digits, valid values 0001-1010, representing the segment content length including Segment Type's length and Field Separators
rules.note: Segment 114 is one of exactly seven segments requiring a 4-digit Segment Length (103, 114, 115, 118, 120, 130, 131) per Section 12's cross-reference table; confirmed independently in segment-120's rule catalog.

rules.title: Segment 114 maximum length is 1010 alphanumeric characters (001-1010/a-z/A-Z)
rules.note: RESOLVED 2026-09-26 (SEG114-SME-001): user confirmed 1010 is authoritative (Section 12.13 opening statement plus its own valid-values range); the Loyalty Card Transaction Request layout table's '1009' figure (Section 11.2.1) is a spec table typo, the same class of discrepancy already resolved for Segment 108 (142 vs 84).

rules.title: Field order is Segment Type, Segment Length, SKU Data (only 3 fields; no field-ordering irregularity exists for this segment, unlike Segment 108)
All fields are separated by Field Separators; a Field Separator follows Field No. 3 (the last field); when a field is not populated, still send the Field Separator
SKU Data (Element 149) is required, alphanumeric, with a maximum length of 1000 characters, and identifies the bar code SKU data
Segment 114 may repeat within a single message, once per scanned bar code SKU; it is not limited to zero-or-one occurrence
rules.note: RESOLVED 2026-09-26 (SEG114-SME-006): user confirmed Segment 114 can repeat for multiple SKUs. This supersedes the initially-proposed 'at most once' inference from the single Field No. 5 table row; the table row represents one occurrence slot, not a hard cardinality limit.

rules.title: Segment 114 never appears without Segment 108: its only documented context is Data Section 3 of the Loyalty Card Transaction Request, where Segment 108 is required

The AI-generated relationship 'The Financial Transaction Request transaction includes SKU Data Segment (Data Segment No. 114)' (source_rule_id REL-ENT-SEG-114-FINANCIAL_TRANSACTION_REQUEST) is REJECTED as unsupported by Section 11.1.1's Financial Transaction Request Data Section 3 companion list, which enumerates only Segments 101, 102, 103, 104, and 111
rules.note: REOPENED 2026-09-29 (SEG114-SME-002): the Chapter 12 segment/transaction matrix marks Segment 114 in the Financial Transaction Request and EMV Financial Transaction Request columns, so the AI statement may be correct. Do not report REL-ENT-SEG-114-FINANCIAL_TRANSACTION_REQUEST as a defect until an SME confirms with a citation. Previously rejected on 2026-09-26.

rules.title: Segment 114 does not appear in the Loyalty Card Transaction Response, which mirrors the generic Financial Transaction Response layout
rules.note: RESOLVED 2026-09-26 (SEG114-SME-003): user confirmed Segment 114 is request-only and never appears in the Loyalty Card Transaction Response.
